name: Tantei Jinguuji Saburou Series No.04: Toki no Sugiyuku Mama ni
original_name: 探偵 神宮寺三郎 Series No.04 時の過ぎゆくままに
source:
As Jake meets up with his friend Scott Kingsley, he starts to reminisce a case from a year ago when he was asked to investigate a burglary of a mansion. During that time, Yulia finds a young boy who is searching for his mother. Little do they know that these two incidents are related to each other. 

[From [url=http://pixelmenu.22web.org/features/saburo/saburo2.html#4]Pixelmenu[/url]]
translation:
神宫寺三郎与朋友斯科特·金斯利见面时，回想起一年前受托调查的一起宅邸失窃案。与此同时，洋子遇见了一个正在寻找母亲的小男孩。两人尚不知道，这两件事其实彼此相连。

[摘自[url=http://pixelmenu.22web.org/features/saburo/saburo2.html#4]Pixelmenu[/url]]
